problem: The fix rebuilt the property test's fourth position as base + " 'x" + junk + "'", with the junk drawn from an alphabet that holds the printable excluded characters as well as the single quote, the control characters and DEL. The test asserts that no such text is ever approved. That is false whenever a draw happens to hold no single quote, no control character and no DEL: printable excluded characters are legal inside a single-quoted span, so for example vsdd survey --flag value 'x$!' is a correct plain call. The grammar accepts it, the parser finds one plain segment, and /bin/sh runs vsdd with the literal argument x$!. The test passes only because the fixed seed 20261124 happens to give no clean draw in its 57 fourth-position cases. With the code unchanged, changing the seed to 1, 2, 3, 42 or 20261125 makes the test fail on correct texts ('x$!', 'x<"', 'x*', 'x*}', 'x<<'). The construction it replaced passed under all of those seeds. So any later change to the draw order, the number of draws or the alphabets can turn the test red with no fault in the code. The comments are wrong too: they say 'no character of the junk may sit inside a quoted span' and call the alphabet 'what a quoted span must refuse'. The per-character pinning is weak as well. With the seed as it is, letting U+0001 alone into _QUOTED keeps all 76 tests in test_caller.py, test_shell.py and test_runner.py passing. Only six control characters are pinned by table rows.
proposed_resolution: Make every between-quotes draw carry at least one character a quoted span refuses. Draw the junk from the current alphabet, then insert one character drawn from the single quote, U+0000 to U+001F and U+007F at a random index. Then assert the precondition inside the test, for example that some character of inner is a quote, below U+0020 or U+007F, and correct the two comments. To pin every control character deterministically rather than by chance, add a loop that asserts vsdd survey 'a<c>b' is refused, by is_vsdd_call and by caller._CALL_TEXT_RE alone, for every code point c in U+0000 to U+001F and U+007F. Check that the test passes under several seeds before keeping one.
